title: I love my mall
content: I’ve seen some posts about their mall being a scary place… I definitely have dreams there where I’m scared/under pressure/being chased, but overall I always have a pervading sense of safety and understanding that I can’t be harmed. When I remember my mall dreams I feel indescribable. When something reminds me of my mall it’s like a jolt of lightning. It’s hard for me to remember my mall when I’m awake so I’m really happy when I do remember parts of my mall. I revisit certain places often. I have never remembered any of my encounters with other people there. It almost feels like heaven or pureland.
